name: HFSP Long-Term Fellowship
amount: Living allowance + research and travel allowance (amounts by host country); child, parental leave and relocation allowances
other_rules: PhD in a biological field conferred within 3 years of the full-proposal deadline (exemptions for illness, parental leave, care, military service)
cannot work in your country of nationality
must move to a country other than the PhD country
no more than 12 months in the host country or with the host supervisor by activation
host supervisor cannot be a former supervisor, collaborator or co-author
lead-author paper published, in press or accepted by full-proposal stage
project must be basic life-science research distinct from previous work (no applied, clinical or purely observational projects)
one HFSP fellowship application per year
notes: 2027 cycle: letter of intent due 12 May 2026, full proposal 24 Sep 2026 (by invitation), outcomes around March 2027, activation 1 Apr 2027 to 1 Jan 2028. Not renewable; deferral possible. A Cross-Disciplinary Fellowship exists for PhDs outside biology.
